name: Input
description: Text or number field with adornments and error states.

contract.element: Native input inside surface/focus wrappers; a custom content div when children are supplied
contract.nativeProps: In native mode, input attributes and events (id, min, step, onKeyDown, ARIA) reach the input. className and style target the surface, not the input.
contract.ref: HTMLInputElement in native mode. Children mode does not render a native input.
contract.state: value is controlled; state.value takes precedence. Use defaultValue for an uncontrolled initial value. onChange receives the native input event.
contract.layout: Use styles.input for field styling and className/styles.root for the surface. Icon/adornment/action slots are separate from input text.
contract.composition: Use Label htmlFor matching Input id. Children mode replaces the input; own your custom child control, ref, and keyboard behavior.
contract.accessibility: Put naming and description attributes on Input in native mode. A placeholder does not replace a visible/accessibility label.

examples.name: Labeled number input
examples.description: Native constraints and keyboard events belong on the field.
